changelog: Initial release - Assume failure is certain, work backward to prevent. By Artem Tolmachev, Teddy Kids, TISA & Claude.
summary: Imagine the project already failed, then work backward to find why. More powerful than risk assessment because it assumes failure is certain. Use when user says "pre-mortem", "premortem", "imagine this failed", "what could go wrong", "risk analysis", "before we launch", "stress test", "what would kill this", "project risks".
